mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (member_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, revoked_at FROM refresh_token WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND token_hash = #{hashToken} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
